create.name: Steve Wolf
create.bio:
Steve Wolf is a yoga and meditation teacher from the Washington DC area, best known for his recorded yoga nidra. He first tried yoga as a teenager with a Brazilian aunt who had practised for years, and his practice deepened in the 1990s alongside a long commitment to Ki Aikido, the Japanese martial art, in which he leads the Northern Virginia dojo. He trained as a yoga teacher at Yoga West near Houston to the 500-hour level, later gained an advanced certificate in the Pranakriya tradition under Yoganand Michael Carroll, and is certified in Baxter Bell's Yoga for Healthy Aging approach.

In 2005 he set up Awase Publishing to release meditation and yoga recordings, starting with Relax Deeply and going on to Savasana: The Art of Deep Relaxation, Yoga Nidra for Kids of All Ages with teacher Emily Gretz, and the Discovering Chair Yoga DVD. His guidance is slow, steady and plain, moving attention through the body point by point in the Himalayan style, with simple breathing and a feel for centred balance that comes from his martial arts training. He has taught classes and workshops at studios in Northern Virginia and Maryland, including chair yoga for older adults, and he has shared his practices on Insight Timer for many years. He is also a professional musician.

courses.title: Relax Deeply: Discover the Ancient Practice of Yoga Nidra
courses.description: Steve's first yoga nidra album, with a short introduction and guided relaxations of fifteen and forty-five minutes set to ambient keyboard music by Cleveland Wehle. Available as a download, with the CD also sold through his publishing site.

courses.title: Savasana: The Art of Deep Relaxation
courses.description: Four guided meditations meant for the close of a yoga class or any quiet moment, including a seated practice and a sense-awareness journey.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra in the Himalayan Tradition
courses.description: Two guided practices in the Himalayan lineage of yoga nidra, including a heart-centred version, sold as a digital album.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra for Kids of All Ages
courses.description: Four imaginative guided relaxation stories for children, made with yoga teacher Emily Gretz, such as a balloon ride and a journey beyond the Earth. The CD is out of print, so it is now sold as a download.

courses.title: Discovering Chair Yoga (DVD)
courses.description: A long instructional DVD for students and teachers with more than sixty short segments, nine ready-made classes from gentle to moderate, and guided breathing and relaxation, with music by percussionist Tom Teasley.

free_resources.title: Steve Wolf on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A large set of Steve's yoga nidra, body scan, savasana and breathing practices, including children's journeys, all free to play in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Sixty One Points Meditation (free MP3)
free_resources.description: A short guided body-point meditation in the Himalayan yoga nidra style that Awase Publishing offers as a free download.
